name: particle-academy/prism-acp
description: Speak the Agent Client Protocol to a coding-agent CLI the user has already signed in to. No API key, no third-party adapter. Laravel-compatible, not Laravel-reliant.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Required on Linux: the process-tree supervisor forks the provider into its own session.
suggest.ext-posix: Required on Linux: the process-tree supervisor uses setsid and signals the provider's tree.
suggest.laravel/framework: Optional: Prism\Acp\Laravel\PrismAcpServiceProvider binds the drivers and config. The core never needs it.
